About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.
Summary
We're looking for an EU Revenue Operations professional to help Dust reach $100M in ARR. You'll own GTM workflows end-to-end, act as a business partner who helps leaders make faster, sharper decisions, and own the sales reporting that gives every team and geo a trusted view of performance. This is a high-scope, high-leverage role on a small team: you'll be dogfooding Dust to reinvent how revenue operations get done, and your work will directly shape how fast we grow.

What you'll do

GTM Workflow Ownership
Own key GTM workflows end-to-end across Marketing, Sales, and CS, from lead routing and qualification through deal progression, hand-offs, renewals and expansion

Remove operational friction so reps spend their time selling, not fighting process

Instrument each workflow so it's measurable, repeatable, and scales, keeping data clean and trusted in HubSpot


Business Partner to EU GTM Leadership
Act as the operational partner to EU GTM leaders, translating their priorities into process, reporting, and action, and anticipating what they need before they ask

Deliver dashboards and reporting leadership can trust as a real-time source of truth

Define and track the KPIs, quotas, and performance metrics that drive the EU team


Build with Dust
Use Dust itself to reinvent how revenue operations works, building agents that automate research, reporting, and GTM workflows (see dust.tt/home/solutions/sales)

Ship internal tools that compound the team's leverage over time

Act as a power user whose feedback directly shapes the product


Requirements
Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude
2-5 years in revenue/sales operations, consulting, VC, or a comparable analytical, high-ownership role

Strong CRM fluency, ideally HubSpot, plus automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n)

Solid data analysis skills (Excel/Sheets, SQL) and the judgment to turn data into recommendations others trust

Proven project management: you scope, sequence, and ship cross-functional work without dropping details

Bonus: B2B SaaS or AI/ML experience, familiarity with the modern GTM stack (Clay, Lemlist, Common Room), and sales methodologies (MEDDIC, BANT)


Attitude
You make the people around you more effective; sales leaders come to you because your work makes their jobs easier

You thrive in a fast-paced startup, stay calm in ambiguity, and bring structure rather than friction

You communicate clearly and keep cross-functional partners aligned

You're intellectually humble: strong opinions, held loosely, updated on evidence

You care about craft and sweat the details, because in RevOps the details are the trust


Agency
You drive outcomes proactively and don't wait to be told what to fix

You own problems end-to-end, from spotting the issue to shipping the system that prevents it

You make decisions autonomously and default to action

You act like a true business partner, taking initiative on behalf of the leaders you support

You see leverage where others see manual work, and you build for it


Compensation and Benefits
€50k-€80k base salary

Equity package in a Sequoia-backed startup

🏡 We offer substantial support for relocation (up to 10k€), including finding an apartment in Paris and supporting you with the visa procedure

Health insurance for you and your dependents

New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, etc.

Beautiful office in the heart of Paris

Opportunity to travel to the US multiple times a year

Regular team events and offsite

We can go higher for outstanding profiles.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. 

Learn how we think and work.
Our product constitution, a story about our mission

Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?
Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.
Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision
Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.
Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.
Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane
Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :
💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant
💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!
🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible
🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours
🚀 Déjà plus de 1 million de TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?
Le segment Experts-Comptables est l'un des plus stratégiques de Pennylane, et aussi l'un des plus complexes à opérer : le cycle de vente est long, progressif, et nécessite un accompagnement précis à chaque étape. 

Les équipes Strat & Ops ont un besoin croissant d'automatiser leurs process et de s'appuyer sur des agents IA pour accélérer et fiabiliser ce cycle.
Le AI & Ops Automation est le point de contact attitré des équipes Strat & Ops pour tout ce qui touche à l'automatisation de leurs process et à la création d'agents IA. 
Il/elle ne fait pas du Strat & Ops : il/elle build les flows N8N, les agents IA (Dust, N8N, Notion) et les skills qui permettent aux équipes de travailler mieux et plus vite. 
Les équipes Strat & Ops restent propriétaires de leurs sujets, vous êtes leur bras armé technique.
Ce rôle est au coeur d'un des défis de croissance les plus importants de Pennylane.
Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?
Tu rejoins l'équipe Growth & Automation avec un focus dédié sur les équipes Strat & Ops Sales ou Customer Success. Ta contribution se joue sur deux niveaux :
Être le référent technique des équipes Strat & Ops sur l'automatisation et l'IA 
Tu es leur interlocuteur direct pour tous les sujets d'automatisation multi-outils. Tu comprends leurs process (avec une attention particulière au segment EC dont le cycle d'adoption est long et multi-étapes), tu identifies les points de friction et tu construis avec eux les solutions qui leur permettent d'aller plus vite. Les équipes Strat & Ops portent les projets et tu les aides dans leurs réalisations.
Construire des automatisations robustes et des agents IA au service des process Sales ou Customer Success 
Tu buildes des flows d'automatisation multi-outils avec des agents IA intégrés (Dust, N8N, Notion). Tu t'assures que ce que tu livres est maintenable, documenté et que les équipes Strat & Ops comprennent ce qu'elles ont entre les mains.
Contribuer à la montée en compétence collective de l'équipe Automation 
Tu partages tes pratiques et tes apprentissages avec le reste de l'équipe Growth & Automation, tu contribues à faire monter le niveau collectif sur les agents IA et les architectures N8N.
Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?
Recueil des besoins et priorisation 
Tu travailles en direct avec les équipes Strat & Ops pour comprendre leurs process, identifier les points de friction et construire un backlog de projets d'automatisation priorisé par impact. Tu gères ce backlog en autonomie, avec un focus prioritaire sur le segment EC.
Développement de flows d'automatisation N8N 
Tu conçois et déploies des flows d'automatisation multi-outils (Salesforce, Lemlist, Modjo et autres) en intégrant des agents IA au sein de ces flows quand c'est pertinent.
Création d'agents IA et de skills 
Tu builds des agents IA (Dust, N8N, Notion Agent) et des skills adaptés aux besoins des équipes Strat & Ops Sales en t'assurant qu'ils sont adoptés et utilisés au quotidien.
Documentation et maintenabilité 
Tu documentes ce que tu livres pour que les équipes Strat & Ops, et le reste de l'équipe Automation, puissent comprendre, maintenir et faire évoluer les solutions sans dépendre de toi.
Accompagnement à l'autonomie 
Tu identifies avec les équipes Strat & Ops les cas où elles peuvent devenir autonomes sur des automatisations simples, et tu les accompagnes pour y arriver.
Contribution à la vie de l'équipe Automation 
Tu participes aux rituels de l'équipe Growth & Automation, tu partages tes apprentissages et tu contribues à la montée en compétences collective sur N8N et les agents IA.
KPIs ramp-up / période d'essai
Mois 1-2 (onboarding & discovery)
Mapping complet des process Strat & Ops et des besoins d'automatisation

Premiers projets identifiés et priorisés avec les équipes Strat & Ops

Environnement technique pris en main (N8N, Dust, stack Sales, stack Customer Success)

Mois 3-6 (delivery)
Premiers flows en production, opérationnels et documentés

Au moins un agent IA déployé et adopté par les équipes Strat & Ops

Backlog structuré et géré en autonomie

Profil recherché
Compétences incontournables
Maîtrise solide des outils d'automatisation (N8N indispensable) : tu sais concevoir des architectures de flows complexes, multi-outils, avec des logiques conditionnelles et des gestions d'erreurs

Expérience concrète dans la création d'agents IA et leur intégration dans des flows d'automatisation (Dust, LLMs, N8N agents) - N8N indispensable

Bonne connaissance des APIs REST et des webhooks : tu es à l'aise pour connecter des outils entre eux sans dépendre d'un dev

Capacité à gérer un backlog de projets en autonomie : tu priorises, tu livres, tu itères sans avoir besoin d'être piloté

Capacité à traduire des besoins métier en solutions techniques : tu sais écouter des équipes non-techniques et construire ce dont elles ont vraiment besoin

Nice to have
Connaissance des outils Sales (Salesforce, Lemlist, Modjo ou équivalents)

Expérience dans un contexte de forte croissance en Strat & Ops, GTM ou Growth

Exposition à Dust et/ou Notion Agent spécifiquement

Connaissance du cycle de vente Experts-Comptables ou d'un cycle long B2B

Expérience attendue
3-5 ans d'expérience en automatisation, Growth Engineering ou équivalent

Profil issu du Growth, de l'Ops technique ou du développement no-code/low-code

Expérience en environnement SaaS B2B

Compétences comportementales
Autonome et organisé(e) : tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire, tu identifies les sujets et tu les avances

A l'écoute : tu comprends les enjeux métier avant de construire

Rigueur documentation : tu ne livres pas sans documenter

Curieux(se) sur l'IA : tu t'intéresses aux nouvelles capacités des agents et tu explores comment les appliquer concrètement

Pragmatique : tu livres des solutions qui marchent en pratique, pas des architectures parfaites sur le papier

Process de recrutement
Échange téléphonique avec Marie, notre TA - 30 min - Remote

Entretien avec François (Head of Growth) - 45 min - Remote

Use case et debriefing avec Bastien (Tech Lead) - 1h - Présentiel ou Remote

Team fit avec l'équipe Automation et Strat & Ops Sales - 45 min - Présentiel

Now we plan to continue to build up our People Ops Team - maybe you are the right person for us?

About Pennylane
At Pennylane, we are reinventing how companies manage their finances — and that means striving for operational excellence and transforming our internal processes. Our People team is at the heart of this ambition: we build the systems, tools, and frameworks that allow Pennylane to scale with rigor, fairness, and data-driven clarity.

The role
We're looking for a confirmed or Senior People Operations Specialist to join a team that moves fast, thinks strategically, and genuinely cares about the employee experience.
You'll be part of a structured yet agile People Operations team, working alongside a Head of People Operations and a People Operations Manager (your direct manager), with 5 specialists each owning a dedicated scope. Your scope will cover Tech and Product on the French market.
In this role, your solid grounding in HR operations and your ability to build robust reporting frameworks and automate administrative processes will be essential levers to support Pennylane's continued growth.

What you'll own
People operations partnering & employee lifecycle
Be the go-to HR contact for ~300 employees across Tech and Product based in France

Own the full employee journey: onboarding, offboarding, contracts, amendments, certificates, absences, end to end and with a high standard of quality

Build trusted relationships with employees and managers, and be genuinely responsive and helpful

Payroll & benefits
Prepare and transmit payroll variables with precision and reliability

Monitor employee benefits (health insurance, pension, meal vouchers) and ensure employees get the most out of them

Process improvement & automation
Spot inefficiencies, build solutions, whether that's a smarter Notion page, a better workflow, or a fully automated process

Lead or co-lead the digitalization of HR tools and contribute to a more scalable PeopleOps infrastructure

Strategic & cross-functional projects
Get involved in projects that go beyond your daily scope: D&I initiatives, EVP, HR tool rollouts

Bring structure, documentation, and operational rigor to everything you touch

 
Compliance & regulatory monitoring
Stay on top of French labor law and ensure the company remains compliant

Keep operational documentation sharp and up to date (onboarding booklet, Notion pages, charters, guides)

 
Why this role is different
Real ownership: you're not executing someone else's plan, you define how PeopleOps works for your scope

High-impact population: Tech and Product are at the heart of Pennylane's growth

Room to grow: as the company scales, so does your scope and influence

A team that values craft: we care about doing HR well, not just doing HR fast


⭐ Your profile
 
Experience & expertise: You bring solid experience as a People Ops Specialist gained within a fast-growing company or startup environment.
 
Autonomy & priority management: You are comfortable working independently, with a proven ability to juggle multiple priorities and stay effective in a fast-paced, ever-changing context.
 
Collaboration: You will partner closely on a daily basis with several HRBPs, working hand in hand to support your scope of responsibilities.
 
Growth mindset: Pennylane is a company in full scale-up mode: a lot has already been built, but even more lies ahead. You thrive in environments where things move fast and where embracing change is part of the job.
 
HRIS expertise: You're proficient in Workday and genuinely curious about how AI & automation can make People Ops smarter, you've already started putting that curiosity into practice !
 
Language skills: You are fully fluent in French and proficient in English.

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.
If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply: who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.
Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).
Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com
We will never ask you for payment or financial information
(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?
Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?
Then Pennylane is the right place for you !
 
Our vision
We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).
We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.
 
About us
Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)
 
In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :
💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants
💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1200 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.
🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe
🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings
🚀 Already more than 1,250,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!
 
Our electronic invoicing track represents a core strategic priority for Pennylane. This dedicated team is responsible for developing our comprehensive electronic invoicing offering for our accounting firm partners and their SME clients (Small and Medium-sized Enterprises), accelerating client acquisition, enhancing customer satisfaction, and establishing operational excellence within this segment.
 
As our cross-functional initiatives expand, we now require robust frameworks for end-to-end process management, data-driven performance analytics, and a relentless focus on operational efficiency and scalability. We are seeking an exceptional, impact-oriented Strategy & Operations professional who will be instrumental in building these critical capabilities and propelling our electronic invoicing track toward market leadership.
 
Why this role matters at Pennylane
 
The Strategy & Operations role will serve as the critical link between our strategic vision and day-to-day execution, working directly with the General Manager for the track. You will help translate ambitious goals into actionable, measurable roadmaps, establish best-in-class metrics, and develop the operational infrastructure needed to scale the business rapidly and sustainably.
 
This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with significant opportunity for leadership and professional growth. 
 
Your responsibilities
 
Strategic planning and execution
- Partner with the product leadership to define, prioritize, and implement operational roadmaps aligned with business objectives
- Design and establish scalable operational frameworks that support our growth
 
Data-driven decision making
- Lead comprehensive analyses to identify market opportunities, operational inefficiencies, and growth levers
- Develop actionable insights and recommendations based on quantitative and qualitative research
 
Project leadership
- Spearhead strategic initiatives and pilot programs from ideation through implementation and measurement
- Identify and manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
 
Cross-functional orchestration
- Serve as the operational nexus between the track and horizontal teams including care, sales, and the other product teams impacted by the electronic invoicing reform
- Facilitate effective collaboration and alignment across organizational boundaries
 
Performance management
- Own the OKR process for the track, ensuring clarity of objectives and accountability for results
- Design and implement robust tracking mechanisms to monitor performance against key metrics
- Proactively identify performance gaps and develop action plans to address them
 
Who we’re looking for
 
Experience
- 5+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations or a related field, with a strong record of scaling business operations in dynamic environments
- Proven track record of translating strategic initiatives into executable operational plans and projects, delivering measurable business impact
- Proficiency in SQL (or willingness to learn) and modern data analysis tools to drive decision-making independently
 
Core competencies
- Strategic vision: ability to connect business objectives with operational requirements while maintaining focus on long-term goals
- Analytical excellence: skilled at distilling complex data into actionable insights that drive business outcomes
- Project management rigor: experience leading cross-functional initiatives from conception to implementation
- Communication and influence: exceptional ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuade diverse stakeholders
- Problem-solving orientation: demonstrated ability to identify root causes and develop innovative, practical solutions

⚠️ This role is Paris-based only, and unfortunately we're not able to offer a fully remote setup.
You'll need to be fluent in both French and English for this role.

Recruitment Process
- Screening interview with Orane - Senior Business Recruiter (30 mins)
- An interview with Antoine - General Manager RFE  (1h)
- A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h)
- A final interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (45 mins)

 
What do we do to make your work life easier
 
🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane
💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package
📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us
🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it
⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness
🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French
💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment
🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

titre: Fullstack Software Engineer (x/f/m) - Ops AI Platform
texte:
Health can’t wait. 
Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.
Alan exists to end the wait.
Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.
So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.
We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.
Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.
🤘 How we do it?
People joining Alan are always surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:
🎯 What drives us - We're obsessed with helping members live healthier
Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, mission above all else

Member & customer-led: obsessed with solving problems and delighting users

🏆 How we build excellence - We hire the best and empower them to succeed
Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density

Distributed ownership: everyone owns their decisions and results

Radically transparent: all information accessible, written-first, async decisions

🤝 How we grow together - We improve through honest feedback and bold thinking
Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care

Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback to help each other grow

Bold contrarians: think differently, try new approaches

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters
Disciplined execution: decisive action with compounding focus

Fight for simplicity: high-impact processes, smart frugality


🤖 Ops AI Platform team 🔀
We're building something that doesn't exist yet.
Imagine a platform where AI agents autonomously handle operational work - connected to every internal and external tool, trained by operators themselves, running safely at scale. No engineers needed. No bottlenecks. Just agents that work.
That's what we're building. The Ops AI Platform will let our Ops team create, evolve, and monitor their own AI agents to automate thousands of tedious tasks. We aim to crack problems no one has solved at this scale.
The project just launched. You'd join at ground zero - shaping the architecture, the product, the entire foundation.
If building the future of work from scratch excites you, this is it.

⭐ Our north star
We’re building ops agents that work reliably and safely, without putting the engineering team on the critical path.
You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering and ML engineering. Our mission is to create the platform that enables building accurate and reliable AI agents, delivering an outstanding experience to our internal Ops team for the creation, iteration and monitoring of their agents, without requiring hard technical skills. Things we’re working on:
💬 Integrate agents at the heart of internal tools - UIs where Ops monitor and take action on concrete business situations. We want AI agents to become first-class citizens in this ecosystem, with context-aware chat modals, allowing users to review agents' reasoning, actions, and provide follow-up instructions - with instant impact on business data.

👥 Empower non-technical users to become autonomous in the creation and maintenance of agents to automate operational tasks at scale: prompting, tools configuration, testing, datasets, replayability, evaluations

🔧 Build a complete set of tools made available to AI agents, connecting to internal and external capabilities: internal business data, external servers, external web dashboards without API, etc.

💯 Safety and accuracy at the core: robust testing, stateful evaluation, progressive rollout, human-in-the-loop to validate sensitive actions, fine-grained permissions and limits

In 6 to 12 months, we plan to increase our scope by owning the AI platform that will power all agentic use cases at Alan - creating economies of scale thanks to common infrastructure and tooling.
If you’re excited by the idea of building the future of work, this is the team for you - we're at the start of the journey.

🎯 Is it you we’re looking for?
We’re looking for Product engineers with 3+ years of experience who get excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in operations.
You’ll work at the frontier of LLMs, tool calling, human-in-the-loop, internal tools UX, multi-agent architectures,	and see your work deployed in production, used by our ops team

You’ll implement new capabilities for AI agents, as well as tooling to make ops autonomous on the creation, evolution, monitoring and evaluation of their agents

You’ll work on making our system scale, going from a few dozen to tens of thousands of tasks automated daily

You’ll have significant influence on system architecture and code quality

You’ll mentor engineers, contribute to our product & engineering culture, and help build the team (including participating in hiring).

You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:
Strong background in full-stack software engineering, systems architecture, with a spike in back-end engineering.

Experience with traditional ML, or LLMs, or ML dev ops is a big plus

Product-minded: you want your solutions to be used, and impactful

Self-directed and pragmatic

Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!)

Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching

Fluent in English (no need to speak French!)

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.
For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits
At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 
Therefore, we offer:
Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your  time as you  wish.

Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

Learning & Training opportunities. A highly  flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.


Important note: we hire people, not roles.
If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.
If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?
Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.
We'll be thrilled to receive your application!
🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.
🔄 A quick note about the process
Note: While you're applying for a specific area,, you may join a different engineering team based on where we think you'll have the most impact. Check out descriptions of other areas here.

Alan is scaling internationally (900+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Operations Specialists to own device security, SaaS platforms, identity & access, and the daily IT experience of every Alaner, while contributing to build projects that remove operational toil.

IT at Alan is not a helpdesk. Run and support take roughly 60% of your time; the rest goes to build projects you co-own with the IT Engineer leading them.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. We staff people according to their strengths and interests, and it evolves over time.

Location: Paris-based. You'll work from our Valmy office at least 3 days per week, with flexibility for remote work on the other days.

Level: B0 - B1

Scope

🛟 Support & Oncall
Own L1/L2 oncall for 900+ Alaners across 5+ countries, with a clear escalation path to engineers

Triage, communicate to users during incidents, and escalate appropriately

Document recurring issues and reduce ticket volume through self-service


💻 Device lifecycle & endpoint compliance
Own the full device lifecycle: procurement, zero-touch enrollment (Apple Business Manager, Kandji), repair, retrieval

Maintain role-based Kandji blueprints and least-privilege configurations

Contribute to device compliance across all countries (MDM, EDR, FileVault) and to audit evidence

Own the physical side: laptop locker, hardware inventory, office equipment

Take over day-to-day device operations as we bring them back in-house from our outsourced provider


🔑 Identity, access & SaaS platforms
Own onboarding and offboarding end-to-end, across both automated and manually-managed tools

Administer Google Workspace, SSO/SAML, licences and access reviews

Manage day-to-day vendor relationships and procurement on your scope


⚙️ Build
Co-own a build project alongside the IT Engineer who leads it

Examples from the current roadmap: rebuilding the onboarding intake, the meeting room audiovisual equipment and room-booking revamp, the IT playbook for new offices, ISO 27001 / ACPR evidence collection

Ship automation and self-service tooling that measurably reduces IT toil


Milestones
First 2 months

Join IT oncall rotation (helpdesk) with buddy/shadowing support

Discover Alan's processes, stack (Kandji, Apple Business Manager), SaaS ecosystem, and identity tools (Google Workspace, SSO, Alan Home)

Handle most typical IT operations issues autonomously (equipment, SaaS access, account provisioning)


First 6 months

Handle IT oncall shifts autonomously, solving most problems that do not require engineer input

Own onboarding/offboarding workflows end-to-end

Have wide knowledge of Alan's processes, equipment, and tools

Contribute to a build project alongside an IT Engineer


First year

Be regarded as an expert on at least one topic beyond the oncall rotation (e.g. MDM, SaaS admin, compliance documentation)

Contribute on device compliance improvements (MDM, EDR, FileVault) across all countries

Ship automation or self-service projects that measurably reduce IT toil, with limited guidance

Lead small to medium IT projects end-to-end


3 years

Fully autonomous on the User Experience & Platform workstreams

Lead medium to high-complexity IT projects end-to-end

Mentor newer team members, reduce bus factor through documentation, automation and knowledge sharing

Automation & AI appetite: scripting basics (Python, Bash) or low-code, and an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

Documentation mindset: writes clear, structured documentation

Learning velocity: Picks up new tools and processes quickly.

Delivers with attention to detail: handles run tasks reliably and consistently

Raises questions and identifies frictions: spots problems, flags them, and suggests improvements

Service orientation: cares about the Alaner experience, and is comfortable proposing a better solution than the one asked for

Que les symptômes s’aggravent. Qu'il faille 6 mois avant d’obtenir un rendez-vous. Qu'on dépende d’un système de santé englué dans le papier et les processus manuels. Et pourtant, c’est ainsi que fonctionne aujourd’hui la santé en Afrique de l’Ouest. Vous attendez, jusqu’à ne plus pouvoir attendre.
Nous existons pour mettre fin à cette attente.
Née en 2022 au Sénégal, Tanel est la première assurance santé numérique d’Afrique de l’Ouest francophone. Elle opère au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire. Nous transformons un marché dominé par les processus papier et des acteurs historiques fragmentés. Avec plus de 30 000 membres, un réseau de plus de 1 200 établissements de santé et de plus de 400 pharmacies, ainsi qu’un chiffre d'affaires multiplié par 7 en 2025, nous avons démontré une véritable adéquation entre notre produit et les besoins du marché, dans des pays qui avaient besoin d’une révolution.
En 2026, Alan, le leader européen de l’assurance santé axée sur la prévention, avec plus de 950 M€ de CA et + 1 M de membres en France, en Belgique, en Espagne et au Canada, a acquis Tanel afin d’accélérer son expansion sur le continent africain. Ensemble, nous construisons l’assurance santé de référence en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone, avec l’ambition d’atteindre 200 M$ de CA d’ici 2030.
Nous réunissons le meilleur des deux mondes : l’expertise de terrain de Tanel, ses relations locales et la confiance qu’elle a su bâtir, ainsi que la plateforme technologique de pointe d’Alan, son expertise actuarielle et son expérience du déploiement dans plusieurs pays.

L’équipe Opérations développe nos capacités opérationnelles et fait évoluer efficacement notre plateforme afin d’accompagner la croissance, d’optimiser les coûts et les ressources, et de diversifier nos produits. Nous avançons vite, avec un fort niveau de responsabilité, et sommes fiers de nous attaquer à des problèmes complexes.
Nous recherchons des personnes prêtes à réinventer, et pas simplement améliorer, l’assurance et la santé en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone, afin de transformer l’expérience de nos membres et de nos clients entreprises.

Construire un moteur de gestion des sinistres à grande échelle : automatiser l’analyse des dossiers, les remboursements et les recouvrements, développer une capacité de détection de la fraude et piloter l’ensemble du parcours, du rapprochement avec les prestataires à la satisfaction des membres.

Industrialiser la gestion du réseau de prestataires : structurer le pilotage de plus de 1 200 établissements et 400 pharmacies, améliorer la fiabilité des paiements, suivre la qualité et développer le réseau dans de nouveaux territoires.

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. 

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 105 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 6 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🔥 Our Business Operations Team
At Joko, the Business Operations team is the powerhouse behind internal innovation. We tackle the company's most strategic and complex challenges and we don't just solve them, we turn them into long-term, scalable growth engines. Whether it's launching entirely new business lines, rethinking revenue infrastructure, or embedding AI into our operations, we lead high-impact initiatives that push Joko forward faster, smarter, and stronger.
Our mission: Help Joko operate at its absolute best, every single day.

✨ Why this role is special
Joko is entering its most ambitious chapter yet. We just launched in the US, we're opening two new countries next year, we're spinning up new business lines, and we're rolling out Joko AI, an assistant that will fundamentally change how our users compare products and make purchase decisions. Every one of these moves runs through our B2B engine and raises the bar on how it operates.
That's where you come in. Our B2B team is scaling fast: bigger merchants, more markets, more complexity. To keep them sharp, we need a Revenue Operations Manager who can turn the B2B engine into a precision machine: a clean CRM architecture, sharp analytics, streamlined processes, and the operational leverage to take the team to the next level.
This is a founding RevOps role. You inherit the first implementation of HubSpot and a fast-moving B2B team, you work hand in hand with a wide network of stakeholders (Ops, Data, Tech), and you get to define what the function becomes. Few roles give you this much white space this early.

🎯 What you will do
Reporting to François Panico, you will own the Revenue Operations scope at Joko and be the strategic operational partner of our B2B team (Sales, Account Management). This is a 0-to-1 mandate: you will design the systems, data, and processes that let our B2B team operate at peak speed and quality across France, the US, and every market we open next.
Build a world-class CRM architecture: You will take ownership of HubSpot and turn the first implementation into a scalable, multi-country CRM. You will design the data model, pipeline structure, and automations that match how the B2B team actually sells and renews, and make HubSpot the single source of truth for everything B2B: clean, reliable, and trusted.

Own analytics and scoring across the B2B funnel: You will build the analytics layer (in collaboration with the Data team) that gives the B2B team and leadership real-time visibility on pipeline, conversion, retention, and account health. You will design and operate client scoring models (lead scoring, account prioritization, churn risk, expansion potential) and turn raw activity data into actionable insights that surface the right opportunities and flag the right risks.

Streamline and scale B2B processes: You will audit the B2B funnel end to end (prospection, qualification, closing, onboarding, account management, renewal, expansion) and make every step simple, fast, and efficient. You will define clear handoffs, SLAs, and ownership across Sales and Account Managers, embed automation and AI wherever they create leverage, and remove what slows the team down.

Be the strategic partner of the B2B team: You will work hand in hand with the BU owners to identify bottlenecks, prioritize initiatives, and unlock the next level of performance. You will turn ambiguous questions (conversion drops, account prioritization, sales-cycle bottlenecks) into structured, data-backed analyses and clear recommendations, and lay the groundwork to scale RevOps as a function over the next 12 to 24 months.

Experience: You have 4+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Operations, or Strategy & Operations, with hands-on exposure to a fast-growing B2B environment.

CRM expertise: You have architected (not just used) a CRM at scale (HubSpot or Salesforce). You know how to design data models, build automations, and turn a CRM into a strategic asset.

The Role
As a Software Engineer, Network Automation - Data Center Fabrics, you will help design and build systems for operating large-scale networks within our data centers. You will apply deep networking expertise to leaf-spine architecture, automation, testing, and production troubleshooting across Ethernet switching, IP routing, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, and VRFs.
This is a hands-on role for a networking expert who is also comfortable building production software. Go and Kubernetes experience are helpful but not required; strong engineering fundamentals and network automation experience matter more.

What You Will Do
Design and evolve leaf-spine underlays, EVPN/VXLAN overlays, and tenant connectivity for multi-tenant AI infrastructure.

Translate data-center fabric requirements and safety properties into clear APIs, data models, validation, and automation.

Build reliable control-plane software that reconciles desired and observed network state.

Design safe change workflows with validation, dry runs, atomic updates, observability, and failure recovery.

Integrate with data-center switch operating systems and management APIs while maintaining vendor-neutral abstractions where practical.

Participate in the on-call rotation, troubleshoot active data-center network incidents, restore service, and turn root causes into lasting improvements.

Review designs and code, explain networking trade-offs, and help raise network engineering quality across the organization.

Develop lab and production tests and turn operational lessons into better software and architecture.


What We’re Looking For
Deep hands-on experience with Ethernet switching, IP routing, BGP-based leaf-spine fabrics, EVPN/VXLAN, and VRF-based multitenancy.

Strong judgment around fabric underlay and overlay design, scale, convergence, isolation, and failure modes.

Experience building or operating production network automation, including desired state, idempotency, concurrency, observability, and recovery.

Strong software-engineering fundamentals in a general-purpose language. You can design, test, debug, and review production systems and are willing to become productive in Go.

Experience with southbound network APIs and structured configuration, such as REST, gNMI/OpenConfig, or NETCONF.

Hands-on experience with major data-center network operating systems, such as Cumulus Linux, Arista EOS, SONiC, Junos, or NX-OS.

Strong diagnostic skills using routing and EVPN state, packet captures, counters, telemetry, and logs.

Clear, pragmatic communication and a collaborative approach to technical leadership.


Nice to Have
Experience reading, reviewing, or contributing to Go code.

Familiarity with Kubernetes controllers, operators, CRDs, reconciliation, or Kubebuilder.

Experience with physical or simulated network labs such as containerlab, NVIDIA Air, EVE-NG, GNS3, or similar environments.

Experience with high-performance Ethernet, RoCE, InfiniBand, HPC, or large-scale GPU infrastructure.

titre: Software Engineer Network Automation, WAN & Edge
texte:
About Mistral
Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role
As a Software Engineer, Network Automation - WAN & Edge, you will design, automate, and operate resilient connectivity between data centers, cloud environments, external networks, and the internet. Your work will span routing, firewalls, traffic engineering, and production troubleshooting.
This is a hands-on role for an experienced network engineer who can build, test, debug, and review production-grade automation. Networking depth and strong software-engineering judgment matter more than familiarity with any particular language, platform, or tool.
 
What You Will Do
Design and evolve resilient inter-site, cloud, and internet connectivity for large-scale AI infrastructure.

Own external BGP policy and traffic engineering at the edge, including route filtering, failover, and capacity planning.

Build API-driven automation for edge routing, firewalls, VPNs, carrier connectivity, and network segmentation.

Coordinate with carriers, cloud connectivity providers, colocation partners, and vendors on design, provisioning, incident escalation, and service improvement.

Design safe change workflows with automated validation and resilience testing, staged rollouts, observability, rollback, and recovery.

Participate in on-call rotation, troubleshoot active WAN and edge incidents, restore service, and turn root causes into lasting improvements.

Review designs and code, explain networking trade-offs, and help raise network engineering quality across the organization.

 
What We’re Looking For
Deep, hands-on WAN and edge networking experience across internet connectivity, data-center interconnect, private WAN, or cloud networking.

A track record of taking external BGP designs from whiteboard to production and debugging them during production incidents.

Experience integrating and troubleshooting stateful firewalls, NAT, asymmetric routing, and redundant edge designs on at least one major routing or firewall platform.

Experience building or operating production network automation using network-management APIs and data models. You understand desired state and idempotency; relevant technologies might include REST, NETCONF, gNMI/OpenConfig, Ansible, or Terraform.

Strong software-engineering fundamentals in a general-purpose language. You can design, test, debug, and review production systems and are willing to become productive in Go.

Operational troubleshooting experience using routing and flow state, packet captures, link health, telemetry, and logs to diagnose production incidents.

Clear, pragmatic communication and effective stakeholder management. You can translate technical needs into connectivity designs and provider requirements, define acceptance criteria and service-level expectations, and provide technical leadership.

 
Nice to Have
Experience with FortiGate, FortiManager, or comparable edge and firewall platforms.

Deeper specialization in external connectivity, such as public-cloud or hybrid-cloud interconnect, or internet transit and peering.

Exposure to edge security and scale techniques such as RPKI and route-origin validation, DDoS mitigation, or global traffic engineering.

Familiarity with streaming telemetry, network source-of-truth systems, and configuration-compliance tooling.

Experience reading, reviewing, or contributing to Go code.

Familiarity with Kubernetes controllers, operators, or other declarative, reconciliation-based systems.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.


What we offer
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

The role / impact
As an Internal AI Engineer at ElevenLabs, you'll be embedded at the frontier of how we scale - acting as a forward-deployed engineer across our GTM, Operations, and Finance teams. You won't just build tools; you'll co-design and ship agentic AI workflows that eliminate manual toil and fundamentally reshape how our people operate.

Your impact goes beyond the code. You'll own high-stakes automations from discovery to production, acting as a technical partner to internal teams. The patterns, guardrails, and tooling you define will become the blueprint other teams reach for - the standard for how ElevenLabs harnesses AI safely and at speed.

The team / how we work
You'll join a lean, high-velocity team with a shared obsession: turning broken, manual processes into elegant automated systems. We move fast through rapid experimentation, work closely with operators and business owners to uncover the real problem, and ship pragmatic solutions without waiting for perfect specs.

What you'll actually be working on
Designing and iterating on AI agents and workflow orchestrations using tools like ElevenAgents, Claude, and n8n.

Integrating AI systems with our core business stack - Salesforce, Slack, Ashby, and more

Building reusable automation services, patterns and shared templates that multiply the output of every team you touch

Owning experiments end-to-end: spotting the opportunity, building the solution, and measuring the impact

Developing evaluation and monitoring frameworks so our AI-native workflows are reliable, auditable, and safe

What we're looking for

Proven experience building and shipping automations or applications in production - you know what it takes to go from fuzzy business pain to something real teams depend on

AI-First Instincts: Strong familiarity with LLM capabilities, prompting strategies, RAG patterns, and a genuine passion for building agentic workflows.

Deep Backend Expertise : Strong Python and SQL and system design patterns (APIs, webhooks, orchestration layers)

A systems-thinking mindset : you design with security, auditability, and blast radius in mind from the start

Builder and AI-First instincts: you don't wait to be told what to build - you spot the pattern, propose the fix, and ship it.

Infra & DevOps Instincts: Hands-on experience operating cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred), Kubernetes, Docker, and enterprise authentication flows

Contract generation: auto-fill creator names, dates, and payout rates into legal templates from form data, and route for e-signature

Payment status alerts: send automated notifications to finance and creators when payments process

Build and maintain the integrations and webhook triggers that connect social platforms, CRM, finance, Slack, and e-signature tools

Own reliability: error handling, monitoring, secrets management, and audit trails so automations run cleanly and securely

Validate and troubleshoot data (SQL) and document workflows so they stay maintainable as the program scales

Hands-on experience building automations with no-code/low-code platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar)

Systems thinking with strong attention to reliability, error handling, and clean data

Comfort with secrets management, authentication, and basic security and audit practices for automations

Clear communicator who can partner with non-technical marketing, finance, and legal stakeholders

You thrive in scrappy, high-ownership environments and are confident building systems from the ground up

Proactively surface and prioritize high-impact strategic and operational opportunities and own them end-to-end from scoping through execution

Work closely with cross-functional leaders to define and manage key drivers of business performance, identifying areas of opportunity and incorporating them into your work

Use AI tools and drive automation to create scalable solutions that combine a broad vision for what is possible with an understanding of the practical demands that constrain them

Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles

About the Role:
Own how our Foundations business teams design, automate, and operate their most important workflows.

Notion is growing quickly, and the processes that run our business — intake, triage, execution, approvals, escalations, reporting — need to scale without adding headcount or losing auditability. This role exists to redesign those processes end to end and to embed AI directly into them, so the work moves faster and the system stays trustworthy.

What's different at Notion: you'll build on Notion as customer zero. You'll design multi-system workflows spanning Notion, Slack, email, support tooling, and internal data, then ship the custom agents, skills, and automations that run them — partnering with Finance, Legal, People, Ops, Data, and Engineering to drive real adoption, not just documentation.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

What You'll Achieve:
Redesign cross-functional processes end to end: Map and optimize core and cross-functional flows for Foundations business teams, making them simpler, faster, and more consistent than the operating models they replace.

Architect multi-system workflows: Design workflows spanning Notion, Slack, email, support tooling, and internal systems and data, with clear states, routing, permissions, and auditability.

Design for failure, not just the happy path: Identify edge cases, controls, and handoffs so workflows are resilient, reviewable, and easy for a business team to operate without you.

Embed AI with clear human-in-the-loop patterns: Define where AI assists, automates, approves, and audits — and make it obvious what AI did and why.

Build and maintain custom agents and skills: Ship the agents, structured skills, and runbooks that power intake triage, summarization, routing, escalation, and reporting for business teams.

Instrument everything you ship: Define success metrics (cycle time, deflection, quality, adoption), measure them, and iterate based on data and stakeholder feedback.

Set the standards others build on: Establish best practices for AI safety, permissions, transparency, and workflow documentation so the patterns hold as more teams adopt them.

Drive adoption and change management: Partner with business stakeholders so tooling gets used because it's intuitive and reliable, and measurably improves day-to-day work.


Skills You'll Need to Bring: 
 Process and systems design depth: 2–6 years in operations design, service design, product operations, business systems, or internal tools, with a portfolio showing systems thinking and measurable outcomes.

We are hiring a Business Operations Analyst to our Business Transformation team in São Paulo!

Manage expectations and effectively overcome objections.

Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

Resides in São Paulo.

Availability to go to the office when required.

Completed bachelor's degree.

Analytical skills to interpret data, extract insights, and generate corporate presentations.

Advanced English required.

An expert in Brazilian labor practices with deep, practical knowledge of local labor laws (prior experience working with Workday is a highly-valued plus).

About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:


🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo


Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:


💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success


 

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Revenue Operations team led by Julien Amoureaux, Team Lead, Revenue Operations. The team consists of 10 Revenue Operations Analysts working across all of Mirakl's suite of products. Together, you'll be driving the efficiency and scalability of Mirakl's sales cycle by ensuring systems, processes, and automation run seamlessly across the organization.

 

Your Impact

Revenue Systems Support


Maintain and improve the tools supporting prospecting, sales execution, quoting, and revenue recognition across all of Mirakl's business units

Administer Salesforce — managing users, permissions, workflows, approvals, and data quality — to keep the sales organization running smoothly

Collaborate with RevOps Business Analysts to understand business needs and translate them into system or process improvements

Partner with the RevOps Tech Lead on system architecture, integrations, data quality, and prioritization

Document solutions, recurring issues, and standard operating procedures to build a reliable, scalable knowledge base for the team


 

AI & Automation


Design, deploy, and maintain AI-agent processes and n8n workflows that automate recurring operational tasks across Revenue Operations

Support business users and RevOps analysts in identifying automation opportunities and translating requirements into reliable, scalable solutions

Monitor automated processes, troubleshoot failures, and continuously improve their performance and usability

Contribute to building a robust automation framework with appropriate documentation, controls, and support processes


 

CPQ Transformation


Support the rollout of Mirakl's new AI-enabled CPQ operating model, coordinating requirements, testing, documentation, and rollout activities

Work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, RevOps, and technical stakeholders to ensure new CPQ processes meet business needs

Monitor the reliability and performance of CPQ processes post-launch and drive continuous improvement

Contribute to migrating from manual administrative maintenance toward more automated management of product, pricing, and approval rules


 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:


2+ years of experience supporting business applications such as Salesforce, CPQ, CRM, sales engagement tools, or related Revenue Operations platforms

Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders

Hands-on experience with or strong interest in AI agents, workflow automation, or tools such as n8n

Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field — or equivalent experience


 

Skills:


Analytical problem-solving with strong attention to detail

Ability to translate business requirements into system or automation solutions

Clear communication and cross-functional collaboration

Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple requests

Adaptability and eagerness to learn in a fast-moving environment


 Tools Used


CRM: Salesforce

CPQ: DealHub or equivalent CPQ platform

Automation: n8n, Dust, AI agents

Data Managerment : Databricks

Sales Engagement: Prospecting and outbounding tools (e.g. Gong, Outreach)

Productivity & Documentation: Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, Confluence or Notion


Languages


English: C2 (Full professional proficiency)

French: C2 (Full professional proficiency)

Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

The Business Operations team is focused on solving some of Figma's most challenging business issues. We are a small team that works collaboratively across Engineering, Product, Go-to-Market, and Operations teams on a variety of strategic initiatives with a direct and quantifiable impact on our business. You will be asked to tackle a variety of unstructured problems, dissect them, synthesize a set of actionable insights and partner in the execution & implementation of the solution. The role requires someone who is highly analytical and strategic, a great communicator, approaches problems in a structured manner, and is comfortable with ambiguity. You'll get substantial senior leadership exposure, focus on the highest-priority business issues and be plugged into every facet of the business.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:


Identify, evaluate and prioritize new product initiatives, go-to-market strategies and operational projects, with an eye toward long term value creation

Partner with key stakeholders across product, marketing, people, sales, and customer experience to understand, scope and implement operational improvements or perform analysis to inform strategic decision-making

Drive execution of approved recommendations, partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver measurable results

Develop executive-ready analyses, business cases, and recommendations by synthesizing quantitative data, customer insights, and market trends to influence strategic decision-making

Establish success metrics and monitor key business performance indicators, using data to evaluate initiative impact, identify opportunities for optimization, and inform future investment decisions


We'd love to hear from you if you have:


6+ years of relevant experience in investment banking, management consulting, private equity, corporate planning, business finance, analytics, or related fields

Demonstrated ability to distill complex issues into structured frameworks and develop concrete action plans

Strong analytical expertise, and extensive experience building integrated models from scratch

Experience building relationships and communicating with stakeholders across all levels and functions

Track record of building processes from scratch & methodically resolving potential road-blocks


While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:


Experience at a high growth B2B SaaS company

Experience partnering with Product & GTM teams

Experience with SQL

Exempt employees are eligible for employer‑provided paid flexible PTO in addition to flexible paid sick leave. PTO is subject to manager approval. Additional benefits may include company recharge days, cell phone and home internet reimbursements, and a number of lifestyle spending accounts. Figma also offers sales incentive compensation for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non-sales roles. All compensation and benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and may be modified by Figma at any time, consistent with applicable law.

Some of the most consequential problems at Figma don't belong to any one team: how our business model evolves as software shifts to AI and consumption, how we price and package what we're still inventing, where the next layer of growth comes from. We're looking for an exceptional operator to own problems like these and drive them to decisions that reach the CEO, CPO, and CFO - and beyond.

As the first Director  hire on our Business Operations team, you'll start with the highest-stakes arena we have today — Figma's business model and monetization strategy (pricing, packaging, our AI credit and consumption models, and the shape of the model itself) — and build and lead the small, high-leverage team that owns it. But the through-line of this role isn't a domain; it's you: a broad, first-principles operator who brings structure to ambiguity, earns exec trust fast, and turns strategy into shipped outcomes.

This is a full-time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:


Take Figma's most ambiguous, highest-stakes business questions from "no one knows" to a decision we can act on — and own the outcome

Set the direction for how Figma monetizes the AI era: agents, consumption/usage-based billing, our APIs, and acquired businesses — with a real point of view on where the model is going, not just where it is

Build and lead a small, exceptional team; set the bar for structured thinking and exec-ready synthesis

Be the partner Product, Finance, Engineering, and GTM want in the room when the problem is hard

Bring a sharp, independent voice into company planning and our biggest capital-allocation calls


We'd love to hear from you if you have:


You’re always the one handed the hardest, vaguest, most important problems

Pair a top-tier strategy foundation (management consulting, private equity, or investing) with operating experience at a high-growth software company (Product, Growth, Strategy & Ops, or BizOps) or a top-tier PE/VC firm

Have a track record of taking ambiguous, company-defining problems from zero structure to executive decision

Communicate with exec-level clarity and influence senior leaders without authority

Reason fluently about a P&L and a business model — strong business and financial instincts

Lead and develop people


While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:


Exposure to monetization, pricing & packaging, or business-model design — especially in the AI/consumption era

Hands-on financial modeling / SQL
