🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

👐 About the team

Alma is scaling fast across Europe. 380+ Almakers, €100M+ ARR, 25,000+ merchants, 10 European markets. One Revenue org, several very different markets, buyers, competitors, and macro dynamics to master. To keep winning as we scale, we need to sharpen every conversation — in every country, at every stage of the funnel.

You'll join the Revenue Enablement team, sitting inside the Revenue org and reporting directly to the Revenue Enablement Lead, one hop away from the CRO. The team is small (2 today, 3 with you) but its scope covers everything that makes the field better: onboarding, playbooks, coaching, tooling, training, activation. If it helps 100+ Revenue team members win, retain and expand across 8+ markets, it's ours.

This specific role is the missing piece. You will capture the signals shaping tomorrow's market — macro shifts, buyer behavior, technology moves, regulatory changes, competitive dynamics — and translate them into winning arguments Alma reps use in today's deals. Not a content creator. Not a pure strategist. A translator between where the world is going and what happens in the next call, the next deal, the next quarter.

You spot where the market is going. You make the field win today.

This position is a CDI based in Paris.

💼 About the job

Read the market and turn it into winning arguments (30%)


Capture the signals that will shape tomorrow's deals: macro shifts (consumer behavior, credit cycles, regulation), buyer priorities per market and persona, technology moves, and competitive dynamics.

Translate them into concrete arguments reps can use in the next call: talk tracks, ROI angles, objection responses, discovery hooks, positioning frameworks. If it doesn't reach the field in usable form, it doesn't count.


Create Revenue content that wins deals (30%)


Build personalized case study narratives — not templates, but stories that make merchants want to buy. Define the arc, the voice-over, the pitch coaching that goes with it.

Co-produce revenue decks, pitch frameworks, ROI presentations and leave-behinds — each one crafted to persuade, not just inform.

Partner with PMM on competitive intelligence and turn their strategic output into field-ready weapons: battle cards, head-to-head comparisons, quick-response sheets.


Train teams to actually use it (25%)


Ship every asset with an activation plan: when to use it, with whom, how to deliver it, what to avoid.

Run pitch clinics, storytelling workshops and role plays — make reps practice, not just read. Track adoption and fix what isn't used.


Build AI agents to scale (15%)


Design and deploy AI agents (Dust, LLMs) for market monitoring, content freshness auditing, first-draft generation and contextual content surfacing for reps.

Push the boundary of what can be automated vs. what requires human judgment.


🧰 You will work with

Gong • Salesforce • Looker • Notion • Dust (Alma's internal AI platform) • LLMs (Claude, GPT)

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job


You are deeply, restlessly curious. Not necessarily passionate about payments — almost nobody is at first, and that's fine. But passionate about understanding. Whatever the topic hits your desk, you dig until you get it. You form your own convictions and you come to the table with an opinion. Ready to defend it with data. Equally ready to change your mind when someone shows you something better. You listen more than you speak, and when you speak, it matters.

You are commit. When you own something, you own it end to end. No half-baked work. No blaming the brief. You care about the craft and you sweat the details — because that's what makes a pitch land or fall flat.

You have 3-5 years of experience close to live deals — ex-PMM with heavy field exposure, ex-AE/AM, or ex-consultant with GTM experience. You understand what happens between a discovery call and a signed contract.

You are a storyteller, written and verbal. You can make a payment case study feel compelling to a CFO in Munich and a Head of E-commerce in Milan — differently.

You are AI-native. You don't just "use ChatGPT." You build agents, design automated workflows, and think in systems. AI is your superpower to scale, not your replacement.


And it will be nice if you also


Have worked across multiple European markets (selling in Germany is not selling in Spain — you get it).

Have formal coaching or training experience.

Speak an additional European language (Italian, Spanish, German).

Have experience in Fintech or Payment industry.


Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

🧘 What’s in it for you

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:


Ownership from day one. No pre-existing playbook to follow. You define the frameworks, the quality standards, the measurement model — all yours to build.

Direct impact on 100+ Revenue team members across 8+ European markets. Your content shapes how Alma shows up in every merchant conversation — every day.

AI as a real superpower, not a buzzword. You'll build agents on Dust (our internal AI platform), automate the mundane, and spend your time on the work only a human can do: craft, judgment, storytelling.

Direct access to the CRO and Revenue leadership. Short feedback loops, real decision power, room to grow the scope over time toward broader Revenue Marketing.

At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

The Mission 🪐
Situation: Malt is dismantling the legacy contingent workforce model across Europe. Fortune 500 enterprises are actively seeking to scale external talent, but they are paralyzed by operational inefficiencies, fragmented tech stacks (VMS/MSP), and outdated procurement frameworks. This ecosystem requires deep, structural disruption.

Your Objective : We are not hiring you to read standard product demonstration scripts. You are being brought in as the strategic bridge for our enterprise pre-sales engine. Partnering directly with top-tier Account Executives, your mandate is to architect bespoke, multi-million Euro workforce solutions. You will conduct complex operational discovery, dismantle legacy corporate bottlenecks, and win technical and functional buy-in from C-level decision-makers (CTOs, CIOs, Chief Procurement Officers) to establish Malt as their institutional standard.
Key Responsibilities ✨
Pillar 1: Deal Architecture & C-Suite Advisory


Action: Command high-impact, client-facing discovery workshops to diagnose operational inefficiencies and digital transformation bottlenecks. Act as a trusted Solution Architect, designing bespoke workforce delivery models that integrate safely and compliantly into massive enterprise ecosystems.

Output: Fully engineered, customized enterprise solution blueprints and value-driven executive ROI pitches.

Metrics of Performance: Deal Win Rate, and Pilot-to-MSA (Master Service Agreement) Conversion Rate, ACV signed. 


Pillar 2: Tender Leadership & Financial Engineering


Action: Build and defend impact models that prove undeniable economic value to deeply analytical Procurement and Finance leaders of our clients, attaching Malt to their company KPIs.

Output: Winning tender submissions and clearly scoped, high-visibility enterprise pilots with definitive KPIs.

Metrics of Performance: Total GSV (Gross Services Volume) Influenced and RFP Win Rate. 


Pillar 3: Thought Leadership & Market Evangelism


Action: Translate complex, bespoke client wins into scalable, repeatable Intellectual Property. Partner with Marketing to author cutting-edge white papers and champion the future of external workforce strategies at major industry conferences

Output: Packaged off-the-shelf enterprise playbooks that upskill the broader sales organization, and published industry frameworks.

Metrics of Performance: Sales cycle velocity acceleration (via reusable IP) and inbound executive engagement.
Requirements & The Skills Matrix 🔍
Proven Mastery (What you have already built):


A quantifiable track record of elite performance in B2B Pre-Sales, Solutions Consulting, or Enterprise Strategy Consulting.

Demonstrated history of independently driving cross-functional alignment across HR, IT, Legal, and Procurement in multi-country transformation programs.

Proven excellence in crafting narrative-driven pitches backed by rigorous ROI models.

Full fluency in English is required. Native-level or highly proficieny in German is a significant advantage.


Skills You Will Deploy & Develop:


Workforce Ecosystem Architecture: Deep mastery of the external workforce space and HR tech space, seamlessly navigating and disrupting legacy Managed Service Provider (MSP) and Vendor Management System (VMS) ecosystems.

Executive Transformation Catalyst: Learning to expertly challenge and redesign the operating models of global enterprises directly at the C-suite level.

Scalable IP Generation: Translating bespoke, complex consulting engagements into highly repeatable, SaaS-like Go-To-Market products and frameworks.
The Self-Selection Filter ❓
This role is perfect for you if:


You thrive on getting in the trenches with AEs to tear down a client's broken organizational structure and processes and structurally rebuild it.

You naturally think in terms of rigorous ROI models, operational workflows, and transformation frameworks, rather than just product features"

You possess the executive gravitas to look an Enterprise CIO or CPO in the eye and confidently challenge why their current external workforce strategy is failing. 


This role is NOT for you if:


You just want to run standard software demos from a pre-written script and pass the buck back to the AE when the complex commercial questions begin.

You are easily intimidated by heavily scrutinized financial modeling, rigid IT/legal compliance barriers, or complex multi-stakeholder corporate governance.

You prefer a predictable, back-office analyst role over high-stakes, client-facing executive presentations and EU travel.
30-60-90 Day Impact Plan 🏁
Day 30: Submerge into the Malt platform architecture, master our financial ROI models, and map our core VMS/MSP integration capabilities. 
Output: Delivery of your first internal mock-pitch and full codification of the Malt enterprise value proposition

Day 60: Active execution in the field. Partnering with AEs on live Enterprise deals, leading your first discovery workshops, and driving active RFPs. 
Output: Successfully scoping, defining, and presenting your first high-visibility enterprise pilot framework to live clients.

Day 90: Full ownership of your metrics of performance. 
Output: Securing technical and commercial wins on major 7-figure GSV tenders, and publishing your first piece of scalable internal IP (playbook or packaged offer) to immediately upskill the sales floor.
How to Join the Mission 🚀
First Contact (45 mins): A high-level screening call with Esra from our Talent Team to align on your aspirations, culture fit, and entrepreneurial drive

Deep-Dive Track Record (1 hour): An intensive interview with your future Hiring Manager, Lukas, to dissect your past wins, ROI modeling, and structural approach to deals

Showcase your skills (1 hour): Prepare and present a tailored Pre-Sales case study to two of our core business managers to demonstrate your strategic discovery and pitching skills in action

Vision Talk (30-45 mins): A final conversation with a C-Level leader to discuss Malt’s long-term macro-trajectory and ensure mutual alignment on scale

Integral in understanding the technical portion of the sales process and aligning messaging with the value proposition defined by the account team.

Dedicated experience in developing and standardizing content and thought leadership around technical topics.




Foster communication between IT and business personnel with prospects, customers, and internal teams.




Recognize technical concerns specific to each customer based on industry, product, company history etc. and anticipate and address specific areas of concern.




Ability to connect and build trust with technical and non-technical teams both internally and externally.




Proven C-Level Exec communication skills, especially CTOs, CISOs and CIOs.




Support customer development teams looking to implement our APIs and connectors into their data architecture.

Technical consulting/implementation experience, preferably with enterprise planning software

Excellent written and verbal communication skills combined with stellar presentation and organization skills




Strong leadership and people development skills




Ability to work in a team environment sharing marketing knowledge and best practices with peers




Strong problem solving ability

Experience with RFP collaboration tools such as Ombud + demo experience tools like Consensus are a plus
